entities.name: Sword of the Realms
entities.description: A tyrite blade forged by Koll for Halvar, able to cut through the Cosmos itself.

entities.name: Koll
entities.description: Dwarven smith and Halvar's forgemaster, killed by Tibalt for refusing him the Sword.

entities.name: Halvar
entities.description: God of battle who saved Koll from Sarulf and is the Sword's rightful owner.

entities.name: Sarulf
entities.description: Monster that attacked Koll and was defeated by Halvar.

entities.name: Tyrite
entities.description: Godly material that transformed Koll's hand.

entities.name: Tibalt
entities.description: Planeswalker who killed Koll, took the Sword, and created the Doomskar.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: Planeswalker who took the Sword from Tibalt and carried it to Halvar.

entities.name: Tyvar Kell
entities.description: Planeswalker who pursued Tibalt with Kaya.

entities.name: Immersturm
entities.description: Realm where Kaya and Tyvar followed Tibalt and met demons.

entities.name: Doomskar
entities.description: Catastrophe created by Tibalt with the Sword, ended by Halvar.

entities.name: Alrund
entities.description: God who advised taking the Sword to Halvar.

entities.name: Arni
entities.description: Rode the raven with Kaya and Tyvar and stayed behind to slow the zombies.

entities.name: Varragoth
entities.description: Demon who attacked the party wanting the Sword.

entities.name: Karfell
entities.description: Realm whose army is the Dread Marn.

entities.name: Skemfar
entities.description: Elven realm whose army arrived to help.

entities.name: Bretagard
entities.description: Realm where the clan leaders advised returning the Sword.

events.summary: Koll, saved by Halvar from Sarulf, touches tyrite and forges the Sword of the Realms as a gift.
events.quote: Koll swore that he would forge the Tyrite into the finest blade the realms had ever seen as a gift for Halvar.

events.summary: Tibalt, disguised as Valki, kills Koll for refusing to hand over the Sword and takes it.
events.quote: After Koll refused to hand over the Sword, Tibalt killed the dwarf and took the Sword for himself.

events.summary: Tibalt uses the Sword to open omenpaths and create a Doomskar; Kaya and Tyvar follow him to Immersturm and take the Sword.
events.quote: they were unable to prevent Tibalt from creating a Doomskar before they managed to take the sword from him

events.summary: Alrund advises taking the Sword to Halvar; Kaya, Tyvar and Arni fly on a giant raven but Varragoth attacks, and they fall near the Dread Marn.
events.quote: Mounted on a giant raven Kaya, Tyvar and Arni flew toward Halvar

events.summary: Halvar closes the cracks and ends the Doomskar, then disappears with the Sword.
events.quote: By focusing, Halvar managed to close all the cracks and end Tibalt's Doomskar.

relations.quote: created from tyrite by Koll, the forgemaster for the god Halvar
Tibalt killed the dwarf and took the Sword for himself
Two other planeswalkers, Kaya and Tyvar Kell followed Tibalt to Immersturm
the forgemaster for the god Halvar
